raw_segments.text: Again, Arifrades ridiculed the tragedians for using phrases, which no one would employ
For example, delta omega mu alpha tau omega nu slash alpha pi amachron, instead of alpha
pi amachron slash delta omega mu alpha tau omega nu, rho epsilon theta epsilon nu, epsilon
gamma omega slash delta epsilon nu yoda nu, alpha chi yoda lambda lambda epsilon omega
sigma slash pi epsilon rho yoda, instead of pi epsilon rho yoda slash alpha chi yoda
lambda lambda epsilon omega sigma, and the like.
It is precisely because such phrases are not part of the current idiom that they give distinction
This, however, he failed to see.
